name: What factors have the biggest impact on the cost of a room addition?

mainEntity.name: What factors have the biggest impact on the cost of a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a room addition is driven by total square footage, foundation requirements, roof complexity, and the room's intended function. A dry room addition, such as a master bedroom or home office, requires basic framing, drywall, insulation, electrical circuits, and finish trim. In contrast, wet additions, such as a primary bathroom suite or kitchen bump-out, require rough and finish plumbing, venting, water supply lines, tile work, and specialized cabinetry. Additional cost drivers include tying into the existing roofline, upgrading the HVAC system or electrical panel to handle extra demand, and selecting custom finishes like hardwood flooring, decorative molding, or custom tile installations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key cost drivers include square footage, foundation complexity, whether plumbing is needed, roofline tie-ins, HVAC or electrical upgrades, and the level of interior finish materials.
